MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The hardware and repair supplies loosely fit my recent interest in practical household projects, but none felt like something I would choose now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Nuts and hose clamps serve different connections from the framing nails, wood screws, and drywall anchors I recently chose; being fasteners alone does not make them useful for the same job.",
    "Cutting wheels, electronic cleaner, and heat shrink tubing assume metalworking or electrical tasks that my recent choices do not establish.",
    "Epoxy and lubricant would need a specific repair purpose before I would choose them, and eighteen rolls of tape or six lubricant cans exceed my current needs."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in nails and screws seems to have been stretched into an interest in almost any workshop supply.",
    "My purchases of large packs of fasteners do not mean I want bulk quantities of unrelated maintenance products."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The intended job, dimensions, and tool compatibility matter more to me than a broad connection to hardware.",
    "My recent vacuum bag choice points to a specific household replacement need; it does not imply that I need general cleaning chemicals.",
    "I choose supplies when they meet a concrete need, so general usefulness is not enough to make me interested now."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized a broad practical maintenance interest but missed the specific fastening and replacement needs behind my choices."
}
